name: Ranged Combatant
body:
Feat Selection

The ranged combatant dragoon style’s feat selection are as follows: point blank shot, precise shot, rapid reload, snap shot, rapid shot, and manyshot.

Dragoon Style

At 2nd level, the dragoon can benefit from their charge on a ranged attack roll without moving by instead dropping prone. This can also be performed while they are already prone.

For longbows and short bows instead the dragoon drops to a single knee, still considered prone for the purposes of standing and other benefits and penalties.

Improved Dragoon Style

At 6th level, the dragoon adds their Charisma modifier (minimum of +0) to ranged attack rolls so long as they are using their Dexterity modifier on their attack roll and either Strength modifier on their damage roll or not adding any ability score on their damage roll (such as with crossbows or firearms).

Longbows and short bows must be composite to benefit from this, and the Charisma bonus is also restricted by the Strength modifier of the bow. Thus a Composite Longbow with a +2 Strength modifier maximum would also only add up to +2 of their Charisma modifier.

Greater Dragoon Style

At 11th level, the dragoon increases the range of any ranged weapon they use by 20 feet. This increases to 40 feet at 15th level and 60 feet at 19th level.

Master Dragoon Style

At 17th level, when the dragoon uses their dragoon style to benefit from a charge on their ranged attack roll they can choose to instead make a single attack in a line equal to twice the range of their ranged weapon they’re wielding.

This line attack requires those within it to make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the dragoon’s level + the dragoon’s Charisma modifier) and on a failed save they take ranged weapon’s damage as if they had Greater Vital Strike. On a successful save, the damage is instead their ranged weapon’s unmodified minimum damage result.
